description: Base mainnet balance for one address: ETH and USDC (human-readable and raw), plus up to 10 ERC-20 tokens you list (with symbol and decimals), transaction count, and whether it is a wallet or a contract. One price for 0 to 10 tokens. Useful for checking a wallet is funded before a payment, confirming a payout or airdrop landed, tracking agent or treasury wallets, or screening a counterparty. Read-only. Not charged for invalid addresses or when Base can't be reached. Paid via x402; see list_prices.

tokens.description: Optional: up to 10 ERC-20 token contract addresses on Base to also return balances for (an array, or one comma-separated string). ETH and USDC are always included.

name: chain_balance
title: Base wallet balance: ETH, USDC and any ERC-20 tokens, transaction count, wallet or contract
